tone: pastoral, urgent, Christ-centered, protective, and confident
target_reader: religion-naive adults and older adolescents near grade 6
translation_identity: firmly dynamic-equivalence, NLT-like in readability but independent
test_purpose: Human Editor-approved source-side packet for Colossians 2:1-5 with post-draft lexical precedents for smoothing and exact audit

sealed_context.instruction: Use only the Greek, the source-side sense brief, and the Human Editor lexical locks. Do not use comparison translations.

governing_rules: Preserve the Human Editor lexical locks in matrix_alerts.
Use struggle-language for the Col.1.29-2.1 agōnizomai/agōn bridge.
Use hidden for the Col.1.26-2.3 apokryptō/apokryphos link.
Use in person for sarx in the Col.2.1/2.5 embodied-presence bracket.
Use bound together for symbibazō in Col.2.2.
Use secret plan for mystērion in the approved Colossians sense.
In Col.2.2 Christ identifies God's secret plan.
In Col.2.3 hidden must not imply elite-only access.
In Col.2.4 the deception sounds convincing.
In Col.2.5 preserve absence in person versus presence in spirit.

verses.greek: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί,
ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως, εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ,
ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι.
Τοῦτο λέγω, ἵνα μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ.
εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.

passage_argument: Paul struggles for these believers so they may be strengthened, united in love, and know Christ with confident understanding.
Because all true wisdom and knowledge are found in Christ, Paul warns against persuasive deception and rejoices in their stable trust.

proposition_map.proposition: Paul struggles intensely for the readers and others who have not met him in person.
He wants their hearts strengthened and bound together in love as they gain confident understanding and know God's secret plan, Christ.
Every treasure of wisdom and knowledge lies hidden in Christ.
Paul warns them against being persuaded into falsehood by convincing arguments.
Though absent in person, Paul is with them in spirit and rejoices in their order and firm trust in Christ.
